none: PAS FindID 1017755: Roman coin: nummus of Gratian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), Arles mint Emperor right, issue of 367-375, Reece period 19, on a worn reddish flan. Obverse description: Bust draped diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: probably [DN GRATIANVS AVG]. Reverse description: Emperor standing right in military dress holding vertical spear, with propped shield. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI].…
